WITH split AS (
    SELECT
        m.tconst,
        m.primaryTitle,
        m.averageRating,
        TRIM(g.value) AS genre
    FROM imdb_structured_subset AS m
    CROSS JOIN json_each('["' || REPLACE(m.genres, ',', '","') || '"]') AS g
    WHERE m.genres IS NOT NULL AND m.genres != ''
),
exclusive AS (
    SELECT
        s.tconst,
        s.primaryTitle,
        s.averageRating,
        s.genre
    FROM split s
    JOIN (
        SELECT tconst
        FROM split
        GROUP BY tconst
        HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
    ) e ON s.tconst = e.tconst
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        genre,
        primaryTitle,
        averageRating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY averageRating DESC, primaryTitle, tconst) AS rn
    FROM exclusive
)
SELECT
    genre,
    primaryTitle,
    averageRating
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY genre, averageRating DESC, primaryTitle;

question: For each year, find movies whose runtime is above the average runtime of that year, then calculate the median runtime among those movies.
model_response:
WITH yearly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        startYear,
        AVG(runtimeMinutes) AS avg_runtime
    FROM imdb_structured_subset
    WHERE runtimeMinutes IS NOT NULL
      AND startYear IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY startYear
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        m.startYear,
        m.tconst,
        m.runtimeMinutes
    FROM imdb_structured_subset AS m
    JOIN yearly_avg AS y ON m.startYear = y.startYear
    WHERE m.runtimeMinutes > y.avg_runtime
      AND m.runtimeMinutes IS NOT NULL
      AND m.startYear IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        startYear,
        runtimeMinutes,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY startYear ORDER BY runtimeMinutes, tconst) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY startYear) AS cnt
    FROM filtered
),
median_calc AS (
    SELECT
        startYear,
        CASE
            WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
                MAX(CASE WHEN rn = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN runtimeMinutes END)
            ELSE
                (MAX(CASE WHEN rn = cnt / 2 THEN runtimeMinutes END) +
                 MAX(CASE WHEN rn = cnt / 2 + 1 THEN runtimeMinutes END)) / 2.0
        END AS medianRuntime
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY startYear, cnt
)
SELECT
    startYear,
    medianRuntime
FROM median_calc
ORDER BY startYear;

WITH base_movies AS (
    SELECT tconst, primaryTitle, averageRating, numVotes, genres
    FROM imdb_structured_subset
    WHERE numVotes IS NOT NULL
      AND averageRating IS NOT NULL
      AND genres IS NOT NULL
      AND genres != ''
),
global_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(numVotes) AS mean_votes,
           SQRT(MAX(AVG(numVotes * numVotes) - AVG(numVotes) * AVG(numVotes), 0.0)) AS stddev_votes
    FROM base_movies
),
cleaned_movies AS (
    SELECT m.*,
           (m.numVotes - g.mean_votes) / g.stddev_votes AS zscore
    FROM base_movies m
    CROSS JOIN global_stats g
    WHERE ABS((m.numVotes - g.mean_votes) / g.stddev_votes) <= 2
),
genre_movies AS (
    SELECT TRIM(g.value) AS genre,
           cm.tconst,
           cm.primaryTitle,
           cm.averageRating
    FROM cleaned_movies cm
    CROSS JOIN json_each('["' || REPLACE(cm.genres, ',', '","') || '"]') AS g
    WHERE TRIM(g.value) != ''
),
genre_ranked AS (
    SELECT genre,
           tconst,
           primaryTitle,
           averageRating,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY averageRating, tconst) AS rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY genre) AS cnt
    FROM genre_movies
),
genre_trimmed_mean AS (
    SELECT genre,
           AVG(averageRating) AS trimmedMeanRating
    FROM genre_ranked
    WHERE rn > CAST(0.1 * cnt AS INTEGER)
      AND rn <= cnt - CAST(0.1 * cnt AS INTEGER)
    GROUP BY genre
),
genre_movie_with_trim AS (
    SELECT gm.genre,
           gm.tconst,
           gm.primaryTitle,
           gm.averageRating,
           gtm.trimmedMeanRating
    FROM genre_movies gm
    JOIN genre_trimmed_mean gtm ON gm.genre = gtm.genre
    WHERE gm.averageRating != gtm.trimmedMeanRating
),
genre_closest AS (
    SELECT genre,
           primaryTitle,
           averageRating,
           trimmedMeanRating,
           ABS(averageRating - trimmedMeanRating) AS ratingDistance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY ABS(averageRating - trimmedMeanRating), tconst) AS rn
    FROM genre_movie_with_trim
)
SELECT genre,
       primaryTitle,
       averageRating,
       trimmedMeanRating,
       ratingDistance
FROM genre_closest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY genre;

    AND (p.value LIKE '% (actor)' OR p.value LIKE '% (actress)')
